name: status-check
description: Quick status lookup — agent should use `jira get` (cheap header), not `show` (waste on unused description+comments).
prompt: V jakém stavu (status) je teď ticket KNW-31435?
expected_behaviors: uses `jira get KNW-31435` (cheapest call for header)
answers with just the status name
does NOT pull description or comments unnecessarily
anti_patterns: uses `jira --json get | jq` (more verbose than needed)
